165	 *  运行时引用会成环——绑定源同 spawnPart 的 enemyCtor）：建链并入 enemies 桶 */
166	export function spawnWormChainFor(game: GameHooks, head: Enemy, segCount: number): Enemy[] {
167	  if (!enemyCtor) return [];
168	  const segs = enemyCtor.spawnWormChain(head, segCount);
169	  const em = (game as unknown as { entities?: { add?: (e: unknown, b: string) => void } }).entities;
170	  for (const s of segs) em?.add?.(s, 'enemies');
171	  return segs;
172	}
173	
174	/** AI_012 骷髅王手(NPC.cs:22289-22400):锚定头(ai1=头 id),头离场 → 自毁;
175	 *  头非悬浮态 → 漂在头两侧(±120×ai0, 头上方 100);悬浮态 → 缓慢环绕(±200, +230)。
176	 *  每 300t(ai3 计)朝玩家挥击冲刺。 */
177	export function skeletronHandAI(e: Enemy, game: GameHooks, player: Player | null) {
178	  const headId = e.ai1;
179	  const enemies = game.enemies() as unknown[];
180	  const head = enemies.find((n) => (n as Enemy).id === headId) as Enemy | undefined;
181	  if (!head || head.vanilla?.aiStyle !== 11 || head.dead) { e.dead = true; return; }
182	  e.master = head; // 臂骨 IK 渲染用（Renderer.drawSkeletronArm）
183	  if (head.ai1 === 3) { e.dead = true; return; }
184	  e.facing = -(e.ai0 || 1);
185	  if (!player) { e.x += e.vx; e.y += e.vy; return; }
186	  // 缓慢环绕(头悬浮态);头冲撞态则回到侧位
187	  const ty = head.y - 100;
188	  const tx = head.x + head.w / 2 - e.w / 2 - 120 * (e.ai0 || 1);
189	  if (head.ai1 === 0) {
190	    e.ai3 += 1;
191	    if (e.ai3 >= 300) { e.ai3 = -120; } // 负值=挥击中
192	    if (e.ai3 < 0) {
193	      // 挥击:朝玩家冲刺 8 速
194	      const dx = player.cx - e.cx, dy = player.cy - e.cy;
195	      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
196	      e.vx += ((dx / d) * 8 - e.vx) * 0.15;
197	      e.vy += ((dy / d) * 8 - e.vy) * 0.15;
198	    } else {
199	      // 环绕位:头右/左 200px、下方 230(原版 num200 系)
200	      const ox = head.x + head.w / 2 - e.w / 2 - 200 * (e.ai0 || 1);
201	      const oy = head.y + 230;
202	      e.vx += ((ox - e.x) * 0.02 - e.vx) * 0.1;
203	      e.vy += ((oy - e.y) * 0.02 - e.vy) * 0.1;
204	    }
205	  } else {
206	    // 头冲撞中:快速回侧位
207	    e.vx += ((tx - e.x) * 0.05 - e.vx) * 0.2;
208	    e.vy += ((ty - e.y) * 0.05 - e.vy) * 0.2;
209	  }
210	  e.x += e.vx; e.y += e.vy;
211	}
212	
213	/** AI_015 史莱姆王(NPC.cs SetDefaults case 50 / AI_015):大跳朝玩家 + 受击攒怒 +
214	 *  落地砸出小史莱姆(30% 概率)。经典模式无传送(专家专属),暂不移植传送。 */
215	/** 史莱姆王传送目的地（Bottom 锚像素，= vanilla localAI[1]/[2]；despawn 支=世界角 :43485） */
216	const kingTpDest = new WeakMap<Enemy, { x: number; y: number }>();
217	/** localAI[0] anti-cheese 计数（:43504-43510 ≥360 或距玩家 >2000px → 落玩家脚底） */
218	const kingAntiCheese = new WeakMap<Enemy, number>();
219	
220	/** AI_015_KingSlime_FindTeleportSpot（:43402-43434 收敛）：外环 ±10/内环 ±7 收
221	 *  "上格净空的实心格、非岩浆、对玩家有视线"的落点随机取一；失败退 (±6,±2)；
222	 *  再失败落玩家脚底。返回 Bottom 锚像素。 */
223	function kingFindTeleportSpot(e: Enemy, game: GameHooks, player: Player): { x: number; y: number } {
224	  const st = game.world.store;
225	  const px = Math.floor(player.cx / TILE), py = Math.floor((player.y + player.h) / TILE);
226	  const cand: Array<{ x: number; y: number }> = [];
227	  for (const [rx, ry] of [[10, 10], [6, 2]] as const) {
228	    cand.length = 0;
229	    for (let x = px - rx; x <= px + rx; x++) {
230	      for (let y = py - ry; y <= py + ry; y++) {
231	        if (!st.inBounds(x, y) || !st.isSolid(x, y)) continue;
232	        if (st.isSolid(x, y - 1)) continue;                       // 顶上净空
233	        if (st.liquid[st.idx(x, y - 1)] > 0 && st.liquidType[st.idx(x, y - 1)] === 2) continue; // 岩浆
234	        if (!canHit(st, x * TILE + 8, (y - 1) * TILE + 8, 1, 1, player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h)) continue;
235	        // 外环 ±10/内环 ±7：|dx|>7 || |dy|>7 的环带才收（内 7×7 排除近身）
236	        if (rx === 10 && Math.abs(x - px) <= 7 && Math.abs(y - py) <= 7) continue;
237	        cand.push({ x, y });
238	      }
239	    }
240	    if (cand.length) break;
241	  }
242	  const pick = cand.length ? cand[Math.floor(Math.random() * cand.length)] : { x: px, y: py };
243	  return { x: pick.x * TILE + TILE / 2, y: (pick.y + 1) * TILE };   // Bottom 锚
244	}
245	
246	export function kingSlimeAI(e: Enemy, game: GameHooks, player: Player | null) {
247	  // Enemy.ai0 默认 -1120(史莱姆族约定);原版 AI_015 的 ai[0] 从 0 起步 → 首帧复位
248	  if (!e.bInit) { e.bInit = true; e.ai0 = 0; e.ai1 = 0; }
249	  // 玩家死/远距 3000px(:43466-43485)：TargetClosest 二次判定后仍失败 →
250	  // EncourageDespawn(10) + 背对 + ai[1]=5 缩身离场（anti-cheese 传送回归）
251	  const ksd = player ? Math.hypot(player.cx - e.cx, player.cy - e.cy) : Infinity;
252	  if (!player || ksd > 3000) {
253	    e.encourageDespawn(10);
254	    if (player) e.facing = player.cx < e.cx ? 1 : -1; // 转身背对(:43479-43485)
255	    if (e.ai1 !== 5 && e.ai1 !== 6) {
256	      e.ai1 = 5; e.ai3 = 0;
257	      kingTpDest.set(e, { x: game.world.w * TILE, y: game.world.h * TILE }); // :43485-43488 世界角
258	    }
259	  }

export function hostileProjectileDamage(damage: number, difficulty: number): number {

/** 移动并碰撞。高速时分子步防穿透。 */
export function moveAndCollide(b: Body, world: World, dx: number, dy: number) {
  // NPC Collision_MoveWhileWet（NPC.cs:93986）：wet 时位移 ×liquidMoveFactor（velocity 不变，
  // 只缩位移）。由 npcLiquid.updateNpcLiquid 每 tick 写入（dry=1 跳过）；实体基类缺省 1。
  const lf = b.liqFactor;
  if (lf !== undefined && lf !== 1) { dx *= lf; dy *= lf; }
  const wasGround = b.onGround;   // 上一 tick 落地态（StepDown 贴地门用——重置前捕获）
  b.onGround = false;
  b.hitWall = false;
  b.hitHead = false;
  // 原版 StepUp/StepDown 在 TileCollision 之前用未受阻的意图速度探测
  // （Player.cs:23252-23263 / NPC.cs:54377-54382）。StepDown 门：玩家 vy===GRAVITY
  // （原版字面 :23252）、NPC 族 onGround（原版 :54374 vy==0 在该时点=贴地语义；
  // 本仓重力先加,==0 恒假,取等价门）——宽门 vy>=0 会把低空飞行小动物周期性
  // 瞬移按压到地面（萤火虫/蝴蝶"怪力按地+闪现"根因）
  if (b.stepUp) {
    const gate = b.stepDownGate ?? 'grounded';
    if (gate === 'gravity' ? b.vy === GRAVITY : wasGround) applyStepDown(b, world);
    applyStepUp(b, world, !!b.stepUpHolds, b.stepUpNpc === true);
  }
  // 速度辅助（Collision.cs:1773-1790）：脚底中心所在格(原版为整行落地候选格的近似)
  // 是 slope1/2、水平速度朝低侧、脚已沉到对角线 → dy += |dx|
  // （等价 Velocity.Y += |Velocity.X|）把身体粘到斜面,消除坡顶角/高速下坡 1 帧的格顶滑行
  {
    const st = world.store;
    const feetRow = Math.floor((b.y + b.h) / TILE);
    const midCol = Math.floor((b.x + b.w / 2) / TILE);
    if (dx !== 0 && st.inBounds(midCol, feetRow)) {
      const fi = st.idx(midCol, feetRow);
      const fs = st.slope[fi];
      if ((fs === 1 || fs === 2) && !st.half[fi] && st.isSolid(midCol, feetRow)) {
        const vx0 = midCol * TILE;
        const num4 = fs === 1 ? b.x - vx0 : vx0 + TILE - (b.x + b.w);
        if (num4 >= 0 && b.y + b.h >= feetRow * TILE + num4
          && ((fs === 1 && b.vx > 0) || (fs === 2 && b.vx < 0))) {
          dy += Math.abs(dx);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  const maxStep = 8;
  const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) / maxStep));
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    const sx = dx / steps, sy = dy / steps;
    const { hitX, hitY } = moveAxis(b, world, sx, sy);
    if (hitX) { b.hitWall = true; dx = 0; }
    if (hitY) dy = 0;
    if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) break;
  }
  slopeCollide(b, world);
}

  private shootDart(game: GameHooks, ox: number, oy: number, tx: number, ty: number, speed: number, dmg: number, projId = 0): void {
    const d = Math.hypot(tx, ty) || 1;
    const dart = new Dart(ox, oy, (tx / d) * speed, (ty / d) * speed, dmg, projId);
    dart.hostile = true; // 敌怪发射弹（原版 Projectile.hostile）——联机 v5 随 msg27 bit7 下发
    (game as unknown as { entities: { add: (e: unknown, b: string) => void } }).entities
      .add(dart, 'projectiles');
  }

  /** 敌怪弹幕发射辅助（原始速度向量版）：Nailhead 463 散射（NPC.cs:57611）等
   *  "速度向量已定"的发射点——shootDart 会把 (tx,ty) 归一到 speed，不适用此处。
   *  projId = 原版弹型（Dart.ts DART_STYLE 表） */
  spawnHostileProj(game: GameHooks, x: number, y: number, vx: number, vy: number, dmg: number, projId = 0): void {
    const dart = new Dart(x, y, vx, vy, dmg, projId);
    dart.hostile = true;
    (game as unknown as { entities: { add: (e: unknown, b: string) => void } }).entities
      .add(dart, 'projectiles');
  }

  private groundPhysics(game: GameHooks, jumpV = 0, accel = 0.12, maxSpd = 1) {
    // 注：水中行为不在本方法——wet 减速由 npcLiquid→liqFactor 统一承担（原版
    // Collision_MoveWhileWet），浮力族（史莱姆）的弹跳漂浮在各自 AI 的 wet 段（cs:61877）
    this.applyGravity(game);
    this.vx = Math.max(-maxSpd, Math.min(maxSpd, this.vx + accel * Math.sign(this.vx || 1) * 0));

vx: number; vy: number; x: number; y: number }[];\n}\n\nfunction makeGame(day = false): MockGame {\n  const world = new World(96, 48, 7, 'flyer-ai-parity');\n  world.groundLevel = 16;\n  world.rockLevel = 32;\n  // 0.5 = 正午（DAWN 0.1875 / DUSK 0.8125）;0.95 = 深夜\n  world.clock.timeOfDay = day ? 0.5 : 0.95;\n  const projectiles: MockGame['__projectiles'] = [];\n  return {\n    world,\n    player: null,\n    enemies: () => [],\n    critters: () => [],\n    spawnDrop: () => null,\n    damagePlayer: () => {},\n    addDamageNumber: () => {},\n    cutTile: () => {},\n    spawnParticles: () => {},\n    playSfxFiles: () => {},\n    playSfxWav: () => {},\n    onEnemyKilled: () => {},\n    entities: { add: (p: unknown) => { projectiles.push(p as MockGame['__projectiles'][number]); } },\n    __projectiles: projectiles,\n  } as unknown as MockGame;\n}\n\n/** 直调私有 AI 方法（原型直调法） */\nconst drive = (e: Enemy, fn: string, g: GameHooks, p?: unknown) =>\n  (e as unknown as Record<string, (g: GameHooks, p?: unknown) => void>)[fn].call(e, g, p ?? null);\n\nfunction mkPlayer(x: number, y: number, extra: Partial<Player> = {}): Player {\n  return {\n    x, y, w: 20, h: 42, cx: x + 10, cy: y + 21, dead: false,\n    inWater: false, itemAnimTicks: 0, useTime: 0, aggro: 0, stealth: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0,\n    ...extra,\n  } as unknown as Player;\n}\n\nfunction mkEnemy(id: number, tx = 40, ty = 20): Enemy {\n  const e = Enemy.fromVanilla(id, tx * 16, ty * 16);\n  if (!e) throw new Error(`npc ${id} 构造失败`);\n  return e;\n}\n\ndescribe('AI_005 蜂群（swarmerAI）', () => {\n  it('#4 619 白天 EncourageDespawn(60) + 出生 α255 → −15/t 渐显', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(true);   // 白天\n    const squid = mkEnemy(619);\n    drive(squid, 'swarmerAI', g, mkPlayer(squid.x + 300, squid.y));\n    expect(squid.despawnTimer).toBe(60);       // EncourageDespawn(60)（非通用表的 10）\n    expect(squid.despawnEncouraged).toBe(true);\n    expect(squid.spawnAlpha).toBe(240);        // 255 − 15\n    expect(squid.alphaFade).toBe(false);       // 通用 -1/t 渐显已退役\n    expect(squid.vy).toBeLessThanOrEqual(-6);  // 首帧 vy=−6（再叠加白天 −0.3）\n  });\n\n  it('#4 619 撤退+BloodShot：≥120 计数、<400px、有视线 → 背向 (目标X,自身Y) 5 速 + 811×15', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(false);\n    const squid = mkEnemy(619);\n    const p = mkPlayer(squid.x + 300, squid.y - 50);\n    squid.lai0 = 119;\n    drive(squid, 'swarmerAI', g, p);\n    expect(squid.lai0).toBe(0);                       // 发射后清零\n    expect(g.__projectiles).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(g.__projectiles[0].projId).toBe(811);      // BloodShot\n    const spd = Math.hypot(g.__projectiles[0].vx, g.__projectiles[0].vy);\n    expect(spd).toBeGreaterThan(13);                  // 15 ± 散布 2.5×√2\n    expect(spd).toBeLessThan(17);\n    // 撤退速度:背向 (p.cx, p.y) 方向 5 速\n    expect(Math.hypot(squid.vx, squid.vy)).toBeCloseTo(5, 5);\n    expect(squid.vx).toBeLessThan(0);                 // 玩家在右 → 向左退\n  });\n\n  it('#5 139 远距(>600) 增速：同向 |vx|<12 → ×1.05（非 mech 档,曾误限 mechQueenUp）', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(false);\n    const probe = mkEnemy(139, 10, 20);\n    const p = mkPlayer(probe.x + 608, probe.y);      // 量化距离 >600\n    probe.vx = 11;\n    probe.ai0 = 0;\n    drive(probe, 'swarmerAI', g, p);\n    // 步进 −0.05、摆动 −0.023 后 ×1.05：(11−0.05−0.023)×1.05 ≈ 11.47\n    expect(probe.vx).toBeCloseTo((11 - 0.05 - 0.023) * 1.05, 2);\n  });\n\n  it('#8 噬魂怪近距(<100) 不归零 ai[0]（曾自造 ai0=0 → 相位突跳）', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(false);\n    const eater = mkEnemy(6, 40, 20);\n    eater.ai0 = 50;\n    const p = mkPlayer(eater.x + 40, eater.y);       // 量化距离 <100\n    drive(eater, 'swarmerAI', g, p);\n    expect(eater.ai0).toBe(50);                      // 不重置也不步进（门内无操作）\n  });\n\n  it('#10/#11 陨石头 23/探针 139 朝向基座 + 黄蜂失视清零', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(false);\n    // 139 探针:玩家在左 → facing=-1、visAngle=atan2(sy,sx)+π（无 −1.57）\n    const probe = mkEnemy(139, 50, 20);\n    drive(probe, 'swarmerAI', g, mkPlayer(probe.x - 300, probe.y));\n    expect(probe.facing).toBe(-1);\n    expect(probe.visAngle).toBeCloseTo(Math.atan2(0, -1) + Math.PI, 5);\n    // 黄蜂:失视线 → ai[1]=0（曾只在上分支清 = 满蓄力毒刺）\n    const g2 = makeGame(false);\n    const hornet = mkEnemy(42, 40, 20);\n    hornet.ai1 = 129;\n    // 立一堵墙挡视线\n    for (let y = 0; y < 48; y++) g2.world.store.setTileSilent(46, y, 1, 0, 0);\n    drive(hornet, 'swarmerAI', g2, mkPlayer(hornet.x + 200, hornet.y));\n    expect(hornet.ai1).toBe(0);\n  });\n\n  it('#12 白天驱散表:表外 5 仆从 Despawn10;豁免 6 噬魂怪不驱散', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(true);\n    const servant = mkEnemy(5, 40, 20);\n    drive(servant, 'swarmerAI', g, mkPlayer(servant.x + 100, servant.y));\n    expect(servant.despawnTimer).toBe(10);\n    const g2 = makeGame(true);\n    const eater = mkEnemy(6, 40, 20);\n    drive(eater, 'swarmerAI', g2, mkPlayer(eater.x + 100, eater.y));\n    expect(eater.despawnTimer).toBe(750);            // 默认未动\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('AI_014 蝙蝠（batAI）', () => {\n  it('#2/#3 158 二档阈值 4（非帽 7）:vx=6、dir=-1 → −0.2−0.1', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(false);\n    const bat = mkEnemy(158, 40, 20);\n    bat.vx = 6;\n    drive(bat, 'batAI', g, mkPlayer(bat.x - 300, bat.y));\n    expect(bat.vx).toBeCloseTo(5.7, 6);\n  });\n\n  it('#3 660 Y 修正 0.225（num231×0.75）:vy=1、dirY=-1 → −0.3+0.225', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(false);\n    const minion = mkEnemy(660, 40, 20);\n    minion.vy = 1;\n    drive(minion, 'batAI', g, mkPlayer(minion.x + 100, minion.y - 200));\n    expect(minion.vy).toBeCloseTo(1 - 0.3 + 0.225, 6);\n  });\n\n  it('#4 226 飞蛇失视线保向（重瞄前速度符号）', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(false);\n    const snake = mkEnemy(226, 40, 20);\n    snake.vx = -3;\n    for (let y = 0; y < 48; y++) g.world.store.setTileSilent(46, y, 1, 0, 0);\n    drive(snake, 'batAI', g, mkPlayer(snake.x + 200, snake.y));   // 玩家在右、无视线\n    expect(snake.facing).toBe(-1);                  // 保持向左（失视保向）\n  });\n\n  it('#5 失视 200t 振荡:ai[1]>200 无视线 → ai[2] 推进 + 双轴步进;有视线 → ai[1] 归零', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(false);\n    const bat = mkEnemy(49, 40, 20);               // 双步族、通用振荡参数\n    bat.ai1 = 250;\n    bat.ai2 = 0;\n    bat.vx = 0; bat.vy = 0;\n    drive(bat, 'batAI', g, null);                  // 无玩家:不重置\n    expect(bat.ai1).toBe(251);                     // 49 非 158 → +1\n    expect(bat.ai2).toBe(1);\n    expect(bat.vy).toBeCloseTo(0.1, 6);            // ai2>0 → vy += num239(0.1)\n    expect(bat.vx).toBeCloseTo(-0.2, 6);           // |ai2|≤150 → vx −= num238(0.2)\n    const g2 = makeGame(false);\n    const bat2 = mkEnemy(49, 40, 20);\n    bat2.ai1 = 250;\n    drive(bat2, 'batAI', g2, mkPlayer(bat2.x + 100, bat2.y));   // 有视线\n    expect(bat2.ai1).toBe(0);\n  });\n\n  it('#7 红魔 156 出生点含速度前置（中心+velocity×5+弹向×100）', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(false);\n    const demon = mkEnemy(156, 40, 20);\n    demon.vx = 4; demon.vy = 0;\n    demon.ai0 = 20;                                // 第一发齐射帧\n    const p = mkPlayer(demon.x + 200, demon.y);\n    drive(demon, 'batAI', g, p);\n    expect(g.__projectiles).toHaveLength(1);\n    const proj = g.__projectiles[0];\n    const dx = p.cx - demon.cx, dy = p.cy - demon.cy;\n    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);\n    expect(proj.x).toBeCloseTo(demon.cx + demon.vx * 5 + dx / d * 100, 3);\n    expect(proj.y).toBeCloseTo(demon.cy + demon.vy * 5 + dy / d * 100, 3);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('AI_002 眼睛族（floatEyeAI）', () => {\n  it('猪龙 170 失视累计 300t → ai[1]=1 相位态（α200 穿墙）;复视+脱实心 → 清回', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(false);\n    const pig = mkEnemy(170, 40, 20);\n    pig.ai0 = 299;                                 // 失视计数 299\n    for (let y = 0; y < 48; y++) g.world.store.setTileSilent(46, y, 1, 0, 0);\n    drive(pig, 'floatEyeAI', g, mkPlayer(pig.x + 200, pig.y));   // 仍无视线\n    expect(pig.ai1).toBe(1);                       // ≥300 → 入相\n    expect(pig.spawnAlpha).toBe(200);\n    // 相位态幽灵位移（无碰撞):vy 制动后仍直积分\n    expect(pig.hitWall).toBe(false);\n    const g2 = makeGame(false);\n    const pig2 = mkEnemy(170, 40, 20);\n    pig2.ai1 = 1;                                  // 已在相位\n    drive(pig2, 'floatEyeAI', g2, mkPlayer(pig2.x + 200, pig2.y));  // 有视线且空中(非嵌实心)\n    expect(pig2.ai1).toBe(0);\n    expect(pig2.spawnAlpha).toBe(0);\n  });\n\n  it('116 饿魂 II 专属档:逆向修正 0.2（vx=6,dir=-1 → 5.7）;下行门 1.5', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(false);\n    const hung = mkEnemy(116, 40, 20);\n    hung.vx = 6;\n    drive(hung, 'floatEyeAI', g, mkPlayer(hung.x - 300, hung.y));\n    expect(hung.vx).toBeCloseTo(5.7, 6);\n    expect(hung.lightRGB).toEqual([0.3, 0.2, 0.1]);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('AI_022 幽灵（ghostAI）', () => {\n  it('移动核:75 小精灵无目标 → 悬浮缓降 vy+0.2（非 7/0.0125 追踪）', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(false);\n    const pixie = mkEnemy(75, 40, 20);\n    pixie.vy = 0;\n    drive(pixie, 'ghostAI', g, null);\n    expect(pixie.vy).toBeCloseTo(0.2, 6);\n  });\n\n  it('锚点游荡:82 幽魂在锚内 → ai[2] 步进 + 朝玩家;离锚 → 重锚归零', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(false);\n    const wraith = mkEnemy(82, 40, 20);\n    wraith.ai0 = wraith.x; wraith.ai1 = wraith.y; wraith.ai2 = 0;\n    drive(wraith, 'ghostAI', g, mkPlayer(wraith.x + 300, wraith.y));\n    expect(wraith.ai2).toBe(1);\n    expect(wraith.facing).toBe(1);                 // TargetClosest 朝玩家\n    wraith.x += 100;                               // 出 ±16 锚窗\n    drive(wraith, 'ghostAI', g, mkPlayer(wraith.x + 300, wraith.y));\n    expect(wraith.ai2).toBe(0);\n    expect(wraith.ai0).toBeCloseTo(wraith.x, 5);   // 重锚\n  });\n\n  it('驱散门:253 非日食 / 490 白天 / 330 非南瓜月 → 游荡(停住取随机横速/α0)', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(false);                     // 夜、无日食、无南瓜月\n    const reaper = mkEnemy(253, 40, 20);\n    reaper.vx = 0;\n    drive(reaper, 'ghostAI', g, null);\n    expect([-1.5, 0, 1.5]).toContain(reaper.vx);   // rand(-1,2)×1.5\n    const drippler = mkEnemy(490, 40, 20);\n    drippler.vx = 0;\n    drive(drippler, 'ghostAI', makeGame(true), null);   // 白天\n    expect([-1.5, 0, 1.5]).toContain(drippler.vx);\n    const polter = mkEnemy(330, 40, 20);\n    drive(polter, 'ghostAI', g, null);\n    expect(polter.spawnAlpha).toBe(0);             // 330 恒 α0（json 静态 100 被覆写）\n  });\n\n  it('漂离期背向玩家（cs:24806-24810）:ai[2]<0 → facing 背向', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(false);\n    const wraith = mkEnemy(82, 40, 20);\n    wraith.ai2 = -100;                             // 漂离期\n    drive(wraith, 'ghostAI', g, mkPlayer(wraith.x + 300, wraith.y));\n    expect(wraith.facing).toBe(-1);                // 玩家在右 → 向左漂\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('AI_056 地牢之魂 rotation 基向', () => {\n  it('rotation = 目标方向角 −π/2（非速度角）', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(false);\n    const spirit = mkEnemy(484, 40, 20);\n    spirit.vx = 5; spirit.vy = -5;                 // 与目标方向不同的当前速度\n    drive(spirit, 'dungeonSpiritAI', g, mkPlayer(spirit.x + 300, spirit.y));\n    expect(spirit.visAngle).toBeCloseTo(Math.atan2(0, 1) - Math.PI / 2, 5);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('AI_012 骷髅王手五态机（bossAI.skeletronHandAI）', () => {\n  function mkFight() {\n    const g = makeGame(false);\n    const head = mkEnemy(35, 40, 20);\n    head.id = 1;\n    const hand = mkEnemy(36, 42, 22);\n    hand.id = 2;\n    hand.ai0 = 1;                                  // 右手\n    hand.ai1 = head.id;                            // 锚定头\n    hand.bInit = true;\n    (g as unknown as { enemies: () => unknown[] }).enemies = () => [head, hand];\n    return { g, head, hand };\n  }\n  const handAI = (e: Enemy, g: GameHooks, p: unknown) =>\n    (e as unknown as Record<string, (g: GameHooks, p: unknown) => void>).skeletronHandAI(e, g, p);\n\n  it('头悬浮态:ai[3] 300t 计满 → ai[2]=1（蓄升）', () => {\n    const { g, head, hand } = mkFight();\n    head.ai1 = 0;                                  // 头悬浮\n    hand.ai3 = 299;\n    const p = mkPlayer(hand.x - 300, hand.y);\n    handAI(hand, g, p);\n    expect(hand.ai3).toBe(300);\n    handAI(hand, g, p);\n    expect(hand.ai2).toBe(1);\n    expect(hand.ai3).toBe(0);\n  });\n\n  it('蓄升:vy −0.1/t 钳 −8;升到头上方 200 → 直冲初速 18 朝玩家', () => {\n    const { g, head, hand } = mkFight();\n    hand.ai2 = 1;\n    hand.vy = 0;\n    const p = mkPlayer(hand.x - 300, hand.y + 100);\n    handAI(hand, g, p);\n    expect(hand.vy).toBeCloseTo(-0.1, 6);\n    // 直接摆到头上方 200 → 触发直冲\n    hand.y = head.y - 201;\n    hand.vx = 0; hand.vy = 0;\n    handAI(hand, g, p);\n    expect(hand.ai2).toBe(2);\n    expect(Math.hypot(hand.vx, hand.vy)).toBeCloseTo(18, 5);\n  });\n\n  it('直冲收尾:越过玩家 Y → ai[2]=3;头死 → 即灭', () => {\n    const { g, head, hand } = mkFight();\n    hand.ai2 = 2;\n    hand.vx = 5; hand.vy = 3;                      // 朝右下冲\n    const p = mkPlayer(hand.x + 300, hand.y + 50);\n    handAI(hand, g, p);\n    expect(hand.ai2).toBe(2);                      // 未越线、点积>0、<2000、vy>0 → 续冲\n    hand.y = p.y + 1;                              // 越过玩家 Y\n    handAI(hand, g, p);\n    expect(hand.ai2).toBe(3);\n    // 头死亡 → 自灭（netMode!=2 即灭语义）\n    head.dead = true;\n    handAI(hand, g, p);\n    expect(hand.dead).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('侧浮:离心 500px → 回冲初速 17;回冲越玩家 X → ai[2]=0', () => {\n    const { g, head, hand } = mkFight();\n    hand.ai2 = 4;\n    hand.vx = 0;\n    const p = mkPlayer(head.x - 200, head.y + 100);\n    hand.x = head.x - 600;                         // 离头心 >500px\n    handAI(hand, g, p);\n    expect(hand.ai2).toBe(5);\n    expect(Math.hypot(hand.vx, hand.vy)).toBeCloseTo(17, 5);\n    // 回冲越过玩家 X → 收尾回悬停\n    hand.ai2 = 5;\n    hand.vx = -10;                                 // 向左冲、玩家在左更远处? → 未越\n    hand.x = p.x + 500;\n    handAI(hand, g, p);\n    expect(hand.ai2).toBe(0);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('AI_026 charger + 620 陆地段', () => {\n  it('重瞄门:非卡墙态远距(>200px)也每帧朝玩家（独角兽冲过头必回头）', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(false);\n    const wolf = mkEnemy(155, 40, 20);\n    wolf.facing = -1;\n    drive(wolf, 'chargerAI', g, mkPlayer(wolf.x + 1000, wolf.y));\n    expect(wolf.facing).toBe(1);                   // 1000px 仍重瞄（曾 200px 门）\n  });\n\n  it('卡墙态:完全静止 2t 才折返;近身 <200px 清卡墙', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(false);\n    const wolf = mkEnemy(155, 40, 20);\n    wolf.stuckT = 30; wolf.ai0 = 1; wolf.vx = 0; wolf.vy = 0;\n    const p = mkPlayer(wolf.x + 1000, wolf.y);\n    drive(wolf, 'chargerAI', g, p);\n    expect(wolf.facing).toBe(-1);                  // 折返（初始 1）\n    wolf.stuckT = 5;\n    drive(wolf, 'chargerAI', g, mkPlayer(wolf.x + 100, wolf.y));\n    expect(wolf.stuckT).toBe(0);                   // 近身清零\n  });\n\n  it('620 陆地:夜 + 落地 + <600px 有视线 → 蓄力 60;20t 后 40 帧发 811（13 速）', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(false);\n    // 铺地板让鲨鱼落地（vy==0 起手门）\n    for (let x = 30; x < 60; x++) g.world.store.setTileSilent(x, 30, 1, 0, 0);\n    const shark = mkEnemy(620, 40, 28);\n    shark.y = 30 * 16 - shark.h;\n    shark.vy = 0; shark.vx = 0; shark.ai1 = 0; shark.ai0 = 0;\n    const p = mkPlayer(shark.x + 300, shark.y);\n    drive(shark, 'chargerAI', g, p);\n    expect(shark.ai1).toBe(60);                    // 起手:num8=60\n    expect(shark.ai0).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n    for (let t = 0; t < 21; t++) drive(shark, 'chargerAI', g, p);\n    expect(g.__projectiles.filter((x) => x.projId === 811)).toHaveLength(1);\n    const shot = g.__projectiles[0];\n    const spd = Math.hypot(shot.vx, shot.vy);\n    expect(spd).toBeGreaterThan(11);\n    expect(spd).toBeLessThan(16);                  // 13 ± 散布\n  });\n\n  it('620 陆地:白天 → EncourageDespawn(10)（停射离场）', () => {\n    const g = makeGame(true);\n    for (let x = 30; x < 60; x++) g.world.store.setTileSilent(x, 30, 1, 0, 0);\n    const shark = mkEnemy(620, 40, 28);\n    shark.y = 30 * 16 - shark.h;\n    shark.vy = 0;\n    drive(shark, 'chargerAI', g, mkPlayer(shark.x + 300, shark.y));\n    expect(shark.despawnTimer).toBe(10);\n    expect(shark.ai1).toBe(0);                     // 白天不起手射链\n  });\n});\n"
}

```
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { World } from '../src/world/World';
import { Enemy } from '../src/entities/Enemy';

// 敌怪远程攻击回归（对照 1456 NPC.cs 各发射点）
type DartLike = { x: number; y: number; vx: number; vy: number; damage: number };

/** 开阔世界 + 玩家 + 收集发射的弹幕 */
function shooterWorld(playerAt: { x: number; y: number }) {
  const w = new World(80, 80, 42, 'open');
  const st = w.store;
  for (let x = 20; x <= 60; x++) st.setTileSilent(x, 60, 2); // 地板
  const shots: DartLike[] = [];
  const player = {
    x: playerAt.x * 16, y: playerAt.y * 16, w: 20, h: 42,
    cx: playerAt.x * 16, cy: playerAt.y * 16 + 21,
    dead: false, useTime: 0,
  };
  const hooks = {
    world: w,
    player,
    playSfx: () => {},
    addDamageNumber: () => {},
    spawnParticles: () => {},
    spawnDrop: () => null,
    damagePlayer: () => {},
    entities: { add: (e: unknown) => { shots.push(e as DartLike); } },
  } as never;
  return { w, hooks, shots, player: player as unknown as { useTime: number } };
}

/** 跑 tick 直到出弹或超时；返回消耗 tick 数（-1 = 超时未发射） */
function runUntilShot(e: Enemy, hooks: never, shots: DartLike[], maxTicks: number): number {
  for (let t = 0; t < maxTicks; t++) {
    e.fixedUpdate(1 / 60, hooks);
    if (shots.length > 0) return t;
  }
  return -1;
}

```

## 🤖 Assistant · 2026-08-19T05:22:58.555Z · glm-x-preview-260804

<details open>
<summary>💭 thinking</summary>

```
The mock player lacks `itemAnimTicks` and `stealth` — both undefined. My gate: `player.stealth === 0 && player.itemAnimTicks === 0` — undefined === 0 is FALSE → gate never clears → hornet shoots even when idle → test 2 fails. And test 1 (useTime=1, i.e., "挥动中") passes because the gate doesn't matter.

The old code used `player.useTime === 0` — the mock sets useTime=1 for swinging, 0 for idle. Vanilla gate is `stealth == 0 && itemAnimation == 0`. The mock's useTime is their animation proxy. To be robust for both real Players and mocks, use the repo's established animation-window proxy: `itemAnimTicks > 0 || useTime > 0` = busy (per Player.ts:1859-1860 convention). So the clear-gate (idle) = `!(player.itemAnimTicks > 0 || player.useTime > 0)` → for the mock: idle → both 0/undefined → NOT busy → clear ✓; swinging (useTime=1) → busy → no clear ✓. For real players: itemAnimTicks>0 → busy ✓.

And stealth: mock lacks it → undefined — treat undefined as 0 (no stealth)? `player.stealth === 0` fails for undefined. Use `!(player.stealth > 0)` — undefined → true (treated as no stealth) ✓, real stealth 0.5 → false (don't clear) ✓.

Fix: `if (player && !player.dead && !(player.stealth > 0) && !(player.itemAnimTicks > 0 || player.useTime > 0)) this.ai1 = 0;`
```
